data.title: Business Statistics Bulletin: Operating Revenue Index Rises 12.2% in September 2026
data.content:
Riyadh, November 22, 2026, SPA -- The operating revenue index increased by 12.2% in September 2026 compared with the same month in 2025, supported by growth across several economic activities, according to the results of the short-term business statistics indicators bulletin for September 2026, issued by the General Authority for Statistics.
    Mining and quarrying led the growth with a rise of 27.5%, followed by financial and insurance activities at 19.3% and manufacturing at 15%.
    On a monthly basis, the operating revenue index increased by 6.6% compared with August 2026, supported by a 37.3% rise in mining and quarrying and a 4% increase in financial and insurance activities.
    The bulletin also showed that the employee compensation index rose by 6.8% in September 2026 compared with the same month in 2025. This was supported by increases in manufacturing, at 9.4%; wholesale and retail trade and repair of motor vehicles, at 6.8%; and financial and insurance activities, at 5.6%.
    The bulletin is one of the statistical products designed to measure the short-term performance of various sectors through monthly indicators that track developments and growth rates in each activity. It covers all economic activities of establishments operating in the Kingdom's business sector.
    -- SPA
13:45 Local Time 10:45 GMT
